decisions.choice: Fixed yellow miniature on a dark stand, no stickers; prioritize recognizable silhouette and real native parts over exact scale
decisions.reason: Bound the first end-to-end design rehearsal; no size or playable mechanism was requested

decisions.choice: Move bell outside the coil with visible clearance; leave neck/bracket unresolved
decisions.reason: User identified bell/coil interference. Native surfaces confirmed intersections; spatial separation fixes that defect without claiming a physical attachment.

decisions.choice: Clear the fourteen remaining R2 surface crossings: translate the full valve assembly 24 LDU toward the front, raise the entire mouthpipe 26 LDU, and replace six vertical slide 3L axles with 2L axles centered at the elbow mouths.
decisions.reason: User requested repair. Keep all 92 physical parts and internal valve/pipe seats. The shortened axles stop inside the wider brick underside cavity instead of piercing its small hollow stud. This fixes interference but does not establish axle clutch in the cavity, slide retention, or the existing unresolved mounts.

decisions.choice: Replace unresolved mounts with rooted stud, pin and axle attachments; widen the coil by 20 LDU at its top/bottom seams to capture real cross blocks, and mount the bell horizontally on a cross axle.
decisions.reason: User requires real connectivity. A tower carries the pipe and valve rails; stud-ended slide axles grip bushes and elbows; a pinned bottom cross block retains the coil. No connectivity exception applies. Physical strength and insertion need trial, independently of nominal graph connectivity.

decisions.choice: R5 lowers the bell axis from Y=-190 to Y=-70 and turns its opening from -X to rear +Z. A two-brick pedestal on two real base studs carries the rotated axle mount. Remove five unneeded tall bell-post bricks, yielding 107 parts.
decisions.reason: User corrected the French-horn silhouette: the bell belongs at the lower rear, not projecting sideways near the top. Reuse the same real throat, cone and dish without scaling. Retain all other model geometry and connections; rerun collision and rooted-connectivity checks.

decisions.choice: R6 replaces the detached rear-facing cone with a continuous lower bell tail, uniformly spaced round outer sweep, short diagonal leadpipe, upper loop and staggered inner slides. One low pinned mount replaces the separate tall black supports. All native parts retain rigid transforms.
decisions.reason: Photo inspection showed R5 incorrectly equated backward with camera +Z and retained a trumpet-like straight pipe. User allows larger scale. This remains a stylized 111-part miniature; ornamental levers, thick tube sections and dish bell are not exact instrument geometry. No user acceptance of appearance or physical buildability is claimed.
